objective: Assess how explicit coating/substrate scenarios affect hydration and initial FXII approach/contact;not reproduce two-hour assay adsorption amounts or activation
current_stage: PC8/PC16 whole-chain AM1-BCC jobs launched;periodic dry packing prepared separately;new substrate MD has not started

substrate_screen.lateral_area_scope: later slab comparison;dry bulk-preparation cells are cubic at matched total BPA count and starting density
substrate_screen.new_parameter_runtime: runs/pc-length-parameters-v1/pc{8,16}/status.json;verify live process and SQM log before claiming running
substrate_screen.comparison_basis: same BPA-unit count per area;chain-end and carbonate-link counts differ,so mass must also be reported
substrate_screen.end_group_assumption: phenolic OH;not user-measured PC end chemistry
substrate_screen.density_scope: algorithmic starting-density hypotheses only;neither is an asserted experimental or equilibrium PC density
substrate_screen.stage_order: consistent long-PC parameter audit,dry substrate packing/relaxation and density review,then hydrated slab preparation

compare_separately: number and location of substrate anchors
coating_followup.matching_requirements: when isolating length effects,match repeat count/area and define anchor and reacted-BPAA counts;do not confound coverage with crosslink conversion

measurements_before_FXII_comparison: PC and coating density profiles aligned to a documented reference plane
time-window changes in polymer height,roughness and water distribution
independent packing/structure variability and finite-chain-end effects
bulk-water ion concentrations and local partitioning with explicit buffer assumptions

FXII_comparison_preparation.trajectory_cadence: choose from contact/solvation observables before running;three frames per10ps is insufficient for contact kinetics
FXII_comparison_preparation.independent_replicas: distinct morphology/approach configurations;velocity seeds alone are not independent structural samples

acceptance: numerical checks permit bounded exploratory controls;physical agreement and sampling define the scope of later scientific conclusions
